layouts.looks: One long horizontal line under the CPU is the strongest stroke on the wall, and the two 45-degree shoulders frame the GAMSC like a collar. The GPU pair stays on the right, so the eye reads a calm left half and a busier right half.
layouts.eye: The crossbar and the GAMSC screen above it.
layouts.maint: Fill at L2 left, vent at L2 right; one drain valve under each pump. Pump R takes its coolant from the GPU (the loop runs so the block is fed on its marked IN port): fill both Pinions above the GPU ports before the first start. GPU swap: close both QDs, unplug the 12V-2x6, lift the card.
layouts.thermal: Reference: about 39-41 C coolant at 425-500 W with the fans at 800 rpm in a 25 C room (options-data 1.5).
layouts.finish: Black & silver (options-loop-look 8.4 B): matte-black Alphacool fittings, clear acrylic 16/13, clear coolant, silver only on the service points (QDs, valves, fill plug, sensor).
layouts.why: 8 heat bends, 2 of them in the x-z plane at the crossbar ends; the offset adapter and the QD-1 vertical need a dry-fit.
layouts.riser: Same card position in every style: string-measure the riser path (estimated 230-260 mm). The 200 mm HYTE may be short; a 300 mm PCIe 5.0 riser is about 75 EUR (options-data 1.1 #13).

cons: +6 joints, so 6 more places to leak-test

The crossbar sits on two 50 mm extension stacks, visible from the side
Most expensive full loop (+107 EUR)

layouts.looks: Industrial: every line is horizontal or vertical and every turn is a black L-connector, close to CSFG’s black build photo. Reads as a machined grid, with six black knuckles as accents.
layouts.eye: The black knuckles at the turns and the square CPU steps.
layouts.maint: As L1. Elbows let you re-cut one leg without re-bending anything.
layouts.thermal: Same coolant temperature as L1: the order of the blocks changes a block’s inlet temperature by about 1 K at most (E: 325 W of GPU heat warms ~5-7 l/min of coolant by ~0.8 K), and the radiators and fans are unchanged. Six elbows add a little restriction (E: under 0.1 K).
layouts.finish: Matte-black fittings carry this one; frosted acrylic (8.4 D3) would soften the grid. Chrome would turn six knuckles into six highlights: avoid.
layouts.why: No heat gun: square cuts and 6 L-connectors. Cuts must be exact (±1 mm), and the two 50 mm crossbar stacks must match.
layouts.riser: Same card position in every style: string-measure the riser path (estimated 230-260 mm). The 200 mm HYTE may be short; a 300 mm PCIe 5.0 riser is about 75 EUR (options-data 1.1 #13).
